overview.description: The BNY Mellon Municipal Intermediate ETF (BKMI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed, seeking to maximize current income through investments in investment-grade US municipal bonds with intermediate maturities that are exempt from federal income tax. Security selection is based on fundamental credit analysis and relative value assessments. BKMI was launched on Jan 12, 2026 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
